predicates.title: Storage account allows public blob access
predicates.description: allowBlobPublicAccess is enabled, permitting containers to be set to anonymous access.
predicates.recommendation: Set allowBlobPublicAccess=false at the account level.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | where properties.allowBlobPublicAccess == true | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, allowBlobPublicAccess = properties.allowBlobPublicAccess

predicates.title: Blob container with anonymous access
predicates.description: A container's public access level is Blob or Container, exposing data to the internet.
predicates.recommendation: Set container access to Private; serve data via SAS or authenticated access.

predicates.title: Storage account public network access without firewall
predicates.description: publicNetworkAccess is Enabled with default-allow network rules.
predicates.recommendation: Set defaultAction=Deny, add private endpoints, restrict to known networks.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess = tostring(coalesce(properties.publicNetworkAccess,'Enabled')), defaultAction = tostring(coalesce(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction,'Allow'))

predicates.title: Storage account allows Shared Key authorization
predicates.description: Account key (Shared Key) auth is permitted instead of Entra-only, enabling full access from a leaked key.
predicates.attack_vector: Leaked account key = full data-plane access
predicates.recommendation: Set allowSharedKeyAccess=false; use Entra (Azure AD) authorization.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, allowSharedKeyAccess = properties.allowSharedKeyAccess

predicates.title: Storage account secure transfer disabled
predicates.description: supportsHttpsTrafficOnly is disabled, allowing plaintext HTTP access.
predicates.attack_vector: Network interception of data/keys in transit

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, supportsHttpsTrafficOnly = properties.supportsHttpsTrafficOnly, minimumTlsVersion = tostring(properties.minimumTlsVersion)

predicates.title: Key Vault uses legacy access policies instead of RBAC
predicates.description: The vault uses access policies rather than Azure RBAC, making least privilege and auditing harder.
predicates.attack_vector: Coarse access grants -> broader secret exposure
predicates.recommendation: Migrate the vault to Azure RBAC authorization.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, enableRbacAuthorization = tobool(coalesce(properties.enableRbacAuthorization, false))

predicates.title: Key Vault public network access enabled
predicates.description: The vault is reachable over the public internet without private endpoint/firewall restriction.
predicates.recommendation: Add a private endpoint; set network defaultAction=Deny.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, publicNetworkAccess = tostring(coalesce(properties.publicNetworkAccess,'Enabled')), defaultAction = tostring(coalesce(properties.networkAcls.defaultAction,'Allow'))

predicates.title: Key Vault soft delete or purge protection disabled
predicates.description: Without purge protection, an attacker (or mistake) can permanently destroy keys/secrets.
predicates.attack_vector: Destruction of keys -> data loss / ransomware leverage
predicates.recommendation: Enable soft delete and purge protection on all vaults.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.keyvault/vaults' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, enableSoftDelete = properties.enableSoftDelete, enablePurgeProtection = properties.enablePurgeProtection

predicates.title: Storage account without infrastructure (double) encryption at rest
predicates.description: requireInfrastructureEncryption is not enabled, so data at rest is encrypted with a single layer only.
predicates.attack_vector: Single-layer encryption weakens at-rest protection if the primary key/layer is compromised
predicates.recommendation: Enable infrastructure (double) encryption on accounts holding sensitive data; pair with customer-managed keys where required. Note this can only be set at account creation.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, requireInfrastructureEncryption = properties.encryption.requireInfrastructureEncryption

predicates.title: Storage account has no SAS expiration policy (long-lived SAS tokens allowed)
predicates.description: The account has no SAS expiration policy (sasPolicy), so account-level and service SAS tokens can be issued with very long or unbounded lifetimes. Metadata only — never enumerate or read SAS token values.
predicates.attack_vector: A leaked or over-scoped long-lived SAS token gives persistent, hard-to-revoke data access independent of Entra identity
predicates.recommendation: Define a SAS expiration policy with a short period, prefer short-lived user-delegation SAS bound to Entra identity over account-key SAS, and set a key rotation policy.

query.kql: Resources | where type =~ 'microsoft.storage/storageaccounts' | project id, name, type, resourceGroup, subscriptionId, location, sasExpirationPeriod = properties.sasPolicy.sasExpirationPeriod, keyExpirationPeriodInDays = properties.keyPolicy.keyExpirationPeriodInDays
